Synthetic point-cloud fixtures: no PLATEAU, survey, or other real data.
Generated by test/point-cloud-generate.py with laspy 2.7.0 + lazrs 0.8.2.
The tool is only used during generation, never at runtime.

cloud0.las/.laz: LAS 1.2 format 0, WGS84 EPSG:4326 GeoKeys.
cloud1/2/3.las/.laz: LAS 1.2 formats 1/2/3, WGS84 EPSG:4326 GeoKeys.
cloud4/5.las/.laz: LAS 1.3 formats 4/5, WGS84 EPSG:4326 GeoKeys + waveform fields.
cloud6.las/.laz: LAS 1.4 format 6, WGS84 WKT.
cloud7.las/.laz: LAS 1.4 format 7, WGS84 WKT + RGB.
cloud8.las/.laz: LAS 1.4 format 8, WGS84 WKT + RGB/NIR.
cloud9/10.las/.laz: LAS 1.4 formats 9/10, WGS84 WKT + waveform fields (10 also RGB/NIR).
LAZ files are genuinely compressed by lazrs, not renamed LAS.
Waveform point formats use packet index zero (no attached/external waveform samples).
Their opaque waveform fields vary, and complete raw records are losslessly round-tripped.
cloud0-pointwise.laz: same genuine format-0 chunk, framed as old pointwise compressor 1.
cloud0-tail-table.laz: same genuine format-0 chunk, with chunk table pointer -1 and footer pointer.
cloud0-item-v1.laz: genuinely re-compressed with LASzip item version 1.

Three invented positions (longitude, latitude, original height):
135, 35, -4
135.0001, 35.0002, 13
135.00025, 35.0004, 28
Scales: 0.000001, 0.000001, 0.01. Offsets: 135, 35, 10.
RGB16: red=(65535,0,0), green=(0,65535,0), mixed=(32768,32768,65535).
Fixtures and generator were authored for this application; no external dataset is copied.
dependency.gml references cloud0.las and cloud7.laz, plus one matching invented GML line.
Open it through the existing CityGML entry; no standalone LAS/LAZ entry is added.
